description: Agent Labor Verification: submit billed labor rates with the agreed rate card: the rate card with its reference, currency, each rate with the labor class or tier it is for, the hourly rate, the weekend and holiday rates and the day it takes effect, each worker’s assigned class, and each holiday the card recognizes; the bill with its reference, currency and each billed line with the day worked, the worker, the class billed, the hours, the rate billed, the premium billed (none, weekend or holiday) and the amount. The signed report gives the rate card and the bill, each line’s rate against the card rate for its class and premium in effect on the day worked, the class billed against the card and the worker’s assigned class, each weekend or holiday premium against the calendar and the card’s holidays, and each rate change against the day it takes effect, and counts them, and names a divergent bill: rate drift from the card, the wrong tier or class billed, a weekend or holiday premium billed on an ordinary day, and a rate change applied before its effective date; then a line amount that does not recompute and another currency, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No card rates, no billed lines, no rate and class the card prices, or no holidays beside a holiday premium leaves those points unverified. Classes match without the words class, tier, level or grade, workers as parties, the card rate in effect is the latest effective on or before the day worked, and rates compare to the cent. This audits rates on work already billed: wever_hire-rate-check reads the rate proposed for a prospective hire against the brief and its budget, while the labor rate check reads each billed line against the rate card in effect on the day worked. Verdict labor_rate_divergent, labor_rate_partial, labor_rate_unverified or labor_rate_consistent. POST /api/labor-rate-check. Reads the labor records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it never schedules or assigns work, never pays wages, never hires, disciplines or terminates anyone and gives no legal advice, which stay with the employer, the worker and their advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Labor Verification reads labor records for work already performed: a timesheet, a work-completion log, the licenses a worker held, an overtime claim, billed labor rates, billed labor hours, worker classification evidence and a wage record, each against the shift record, the agreed task list, the dates worked, the hours record, the rate card, the contracted labor scope, the classification claimed or the verified hours and agreed rates it answers to. The family checks hours, work, credentials and pay after the work is done; the Agent Hiring family checks decisions and documents before engagement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-labor-verification-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-labor-verification/.
